title: Branch SME Service Survey 2021
summary: A short intercept survey of SME customers visiting Metro Manila branches about loan paperwork and waiting times.

findings.text: 52% of SME customers said loan paperwork was the slowest part of borrowing (base n=180).
Fees were cited by 12% of SME customers as a reason they had not applied for a loan (base n=180).
44% of SME customers said they would prefer a named relationship manager to an online form (base n=180).
